verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a first-party MCP Server that lets AI agents work with its payment platform in natural language. Documented uses include querying and monitoring transactions, issuing virtual cards and setting spend controls. However, the natural-language layer depends on the user's own AI agent, and the server covers only a designated subset of Core API endpoints. missing for 10: a native built-in natural-language interface, documented full coverage of product operations beyond the designated endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Marqeta Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server allows your AI agents to interact seamlessly with Marqeta's payment platform using natural language processing (NLP).
Transaction intelligence: Query, analyze, and monitor payment activity through natural language interactions.
Use the Marqeta MCP Server with your own AI agents to query data from a designated set of Marqeta's Core API endpoints.
Virtual card issuance: Create instant-issue virtual cards that are ready for immediate use.
